title: Default Visible Restart Verification For Control Plane Services
specification:
# PRD: Default Visible Restart Verification For Control Plane Services

Priority: high

## Problem
Control-plane restart currently relaunches the server and bridge as detached background processes with output redirected to managed log files, so operators cannot watch the real restarted processes open and run on their device by default.

## Goal
Make restart visibly verifiable on the operator machine by default by launching restarted control-plane services in a visible terminal session instead of only in detached background mode.

## Requirements
- Add a restart launch mode for control-plane services that can open a visible terminal session on the local machine during restart.
- Make the visible mode the default for this repo's local control-plane restart flow unless explicitly configured otherwise.
- Preserve the existing detached/background mode as a supported fallback or configuration option for later subprocess-based operation.
- Record enough lifecycle metadata to distinguish visible-terminal launches from detached launches.
- Capture clear restart result data so the dashboard can report whether a visible terminal was opened, which target was launched, and whether launch succeeded or failed.
- Define the supported platform scope explicitly; if cross-platform is not implemented, support macOS first and report unsupported platforms clearly.
- Keep the bridge restart flow safe so the bridge can still complete or terminally record the job before replacing itself.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Triggering Restart services for this repo opens visible terminal session(s) for the relaunched server and bridge by default on the supported local platform.
- The relaunched processes are still registered in lifecycle metadata and reported back to the control plane with success or failure status.
- Operators can tell from the UI/job result whether the terminal-launch verification path was used.
- If visible terminal launch is unavailable or fails, the system reports a clear reason and either falls back to detached mode when configured or fails safely without pretending verification occurred.
- Existing detached restart behavior remains available behind configuration or as a fallback path.

## Verification
- Add unit coverage for restart mode selection and lifecycle/result recording.
- Add integration coverage for terminal-launch command construction and fallback/error handling.
- Manually verify on a macOS machine that clicking Restart services opens the expected terminal session(s), the services relaunch successfully, and the control plane reports the visible restart outcome.
- Run `npm run typecheck` and relevant control-plane restart tests.
